test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

These instructions can be easily carried out.

options.text: One will be able to carry out these instructions easily.
You should easily carry out these instructions.
One can easily carry out these instructions.
I would easily carry out these instructions.

solution:
The active voice of the given sentence is __**One can easily carry out these instructions.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Modal verb: 

Modal verbs **are used to express certain hypothetical conditions, such as **advice, capability, or requests** (there’s a full list in the next section). 

 
 
 
 

 Passive
 
 Active
 
 
 

 Object + can + be + V3 + by + subject
 
 Subject + can + V1 + object.
 
 
 

__
 
• 
 The instructions given below should be followed while changing a passive voice to an active voice.

 
 
• 
 Find the subject and obje**c****t** of the sentence and exchange their places; make changes in their cases as well if subject and object are pronouns.
 
 
• 
 Remove the preposition 'by' before the agent.
 
 
• 
 Change** 'can b****e'** of the passive voice into 'can' to make it an active voice.
 
 
• 
 At last line up the remaining part.
 
 
 

So, the final sentence is - *One can easily carry out these instructions.*
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__Impersonal Passive__

 
• Verbs without an object **(intransitive verb)** normally cannot form a personal passive sentence (as there is no object that can become the subject of the passive sentence). If you want to use an intransitive verb in passive voice, you need an impersonal construction – therefore this passive voice is called Impersonal Passive.
 
• Example: he says – it is said
